Which medication is a benzodiazepine?
A: Buspirone
B. Escitalopram
C. Zolpidem
D. Lorazepam


Answer is D: lorazepam. Benzodiazepines tend to end with -pam/-lam (ex: lorazepam, diazepam, alprazolam). They calm the CNS by enhancing the neurotransmitter GABA (an inhibitory neurotransmitter). Remember these simple tricks:

Clouds over Trees: White (RA) above Green (RL).

Coal over Fire: Black (LA) above Red (LL).

Chocolate Near My Heart: Brown (V1) at the 4th intercostal space, right sternal border.

These memory tricks use the AHA colour system. Always follow your facility’s electrode placement guidelines.
